findings.summary: The Nudge affordance claims to deliver an in-app card, but it only writes a MessageDraft: no send operation invokes it, and no policy (policy.revocation or policy.pairConsent) governs it, so nothing enforces the revocation check against current state that the S.webapp.concurrency 'send' authorization and C.webapp.nudge.single require.
The new hard criterion has no sourceRefs and no requirement (S.webapp.*) that specifies nudges, unlike every other criterion, so the nudge feature is not traced to any requirement or feature.

The evolution lists only the nudge affordance and MessageDraft as affected nodes, even though the change also modifies component.PersonActionBar and screen.person (new action) and adds a MessageDraft storage link to binding.contactsStore.
